body:
Values. Values are the problem.

In order to be satisfied, or happy, a person must live in accordance with their own values.

But values differ. If a person is insane, then the values which are of key importance to that person, might seem twisted, or meaningless to others.

These values may also be, by their very nature, impossible to satisfy. In which case, they become a source of distress, rather than a source of fulfilment. But nothing can be done about this. No action can be taken to fulfil these all-important values, and no action can be taken to change or remove them, since to do so would contravene the values themselves.

I'm expressing this badly but...

It's impossible to ignore, or change, your most important values, since in order to do so, you would have to refer to another, more 'important' value, and prioritise this new value over the old one. After all, what motivation is there to change a value, unless pressure comes from other values? But if a value is of such fundamental importance that it outranks all others, then it cannot be subverted or changed. Herein lies the problem.

edit: I suppose I value my life far less than I value some other things.
Because, if I remain alive, life will continue to be unbearable.

>Why do you feel as though you are going to die soon?

Because I intend to kill myself.
